reviews.text: Rob is the best! He’s been watching my dog Watley since he was a puppy and now he’s 10! Rob is flexible with his schedule, reliable and has fair pricing. I always have peace of mind when Watley is in his care. Can’t recommend him enough!

I’ve known Rob for 15 years and have watched him pour himself into building this business from the ground up. I’ve spent time in his training space and have seen how thoughtful, patient, and committed he is with the dogs in his care. It’s not just work for him — it’s clearly a calling. I would trust him with my own pets without hesitation.

Rob is such a wonderful and caring dog sitter and trainer. Our dog Willa is leash reactive and Rob handles that very well. She has enjoyed long weekends and trips up to three weeks long. In addition to sitting, Willa has also received training from Rob and learned a new skill we had struggled with teaching her (dropping a toy!) All the dogs that stay with Rob are so friendly and Willa always has a great time socializing (especially with resident pup Tito). I get great pictures and clear, consistent communication and calendar invites which is very important to me. Finally, Willa had a medical condition one time during a visit and Rob supported us through that, sending pictures, and making sure she could get to the vet and be seen. He is a great dog sitter and trainer and we are so grateful to have him in our neighborhood!

My pup loves his Rob and Tito visits! Rob’s super flexible and attentive. On multiple occasions he’s asked about my dog’s quirks to ensure things were alright, which gives me confidence that he’s being cared for. Rates are super reasonable, would definitely recommend!!
Rob is excellent, very professional and caring.

Lucy loves Rob and we love Rob! He is flexible, responsive, and dependable. He literally started walked our pup the day after we got her and continues to walk our girl Monday to Friday 3 years later.  We are so so thankful that he always puts in the extra effort to exercise our hyper doodle girl. It makes a huge difference! Rob also boards Lucy when we go away, so it’s always nice to know she is with someone she knows and loves when we are away. 10/10 recommend!

Rob is a terrific caregiver for our pets. He has walked, well exercised, and boarded my rescue lab for nearly five years. Henry has Addison’s which requires extra vigilance and Rob got him emergency lifesaving care when I was overseas for which I am forever grateful. He posts daily photos and updates and it is always amusing and reassuring to see how well all the animals in his care get along. I trust him completely as do many of my dog park friends.

Rob has been out pat sitter for 4 years since we rescued our very nervous large pit mix pup
He is great, very patient, very comfortable with large breads and very knowledgeable.
We have left Buddy with him for as long as 2 weeks
He has always been great
I highly recommend him with no reservations

Rob has been watching our dog Rosie for two and a half years and he is the BEST. From walks to overnights to week-long stays, Rosie always has the best time. When I drop her off at Rob's house, she runs straight into the door and wags her tail like crazy. She's best friends with his dog Tito and loves playing with all the other dogs. Rob teaches her manners and sends her home happy and tired. His service and prices are unparalleled, we cannot recommend him enough!
Rob is fantastic and communicative. He’s been watching our pup for over 7 years.

Rob has been a trusted and caring Dogwalker for our two large cane corsos for several years. He is so patient - even our reactive puppy warmed up to him in no time. I would highly recommend him as a reliable and knowledgeable animal caretaker.

Rob is great!  Our dog loves going to Rob's and it is our favorite place to send him while we are out of town.  Rob communicates excellently and took the time to get to know Howie and make sure he is comfortable.  Strongly recommend.

Rob is a fantastic caregiver for our 80lb pup. He is reliable, friendly, and professional. We have used him both for dog walking and for boarding, and he has become one of our dog's favorite people to see walking around the park and neighborhood.

Rob takes amazing care of our pup when boarding. He even goes above and beyond and takes my pup to the local dog park to run him out. Also my pup has bonded with Rob’s dog Tito and so he gets to not only play outside at the dog park but gets to play inside all day with Tito. When I pick him up, he’s super satisfied and tired for days. Can’t recommend rob enough!

Rob has been watching my pup for over a week at a time for a few years now and we'll keep coming back even though we don't live very close by.
Not only does he take good, personalized care (my dog loves to run and play and he takes her to the dog park all the time), but he's very organized which I appreciate so much! As a detail oriented person, I really appreciate that Rob has clear pricing, transparent scheduling, sends pictures daily, takes notes when you tell him about your dog, and communicates promptly. He's clear, reliable, and responsible in a way that most other dogsitters - who may otherwise be wonderful - aren't, and shows his trustworthiness. He's also so accommodating to changes and when we're running late.

My 7 year old Boston Terrier Pearl, who was a rescue and has a lot of issues, absolutely loves spending overnights at Robs! He is reliable and his love for animals shows. I never have to worry about Pearls happiness or wellbeing when he is watching her.

Rob is an absolutely fantastic boarder and dog walker. We have been working with Rob for many months, including taking frequent 1-2 week long trips out of town, and leaving our precious 8 year old pitbull with Rob. The boarding environment …
